explicit_caloocan_facts.statement: Official indexed NDRRMC SitRep content contains a Caloocan section with eleven rows whose incident type is written as Flooded Areas.
Ten Caloocan rows have 02 September 2024 occurrence entries and later revisions state Subsided as of 03 September 8:00am.

Later indexed revisions list Crispulo st. at 05 September 2024, 07:00 am with 2-3 feet and Flooded as of 05 September 7:00am; its status changes across revisions without an explicit cessation timestamp.
Report #41 Annex A explicitly lists Caloocan City with 6 affected barangays, 3,250 affected families, and 12,754 affected persons.
Report #41 explicitly records DSWD FO NCR food-pack augmentation actions involving the LGU of Caloocan on 03, 06, and 07 September 2024.

occurrence_time_evidence.statement: The NDRRMC Caloocan incident table explicitly labels 02 September 2024, 08:00 am as the occurrence date/time for nine rows and 08:00 pm for 185, Everlasting.
Later indexed NDRRMC revisions explicitly label Crispulo st. with occurrence date 05 September 2024 and occurrence time 07:00 am.

location_evidence.statement: Numbered locations are preserved exactly as 172, North Olympus; 172, Dona Aurora; 185, Everlasting; 185, Quirino highway Malaria; 174, 1456 Camarin rd; and 177, Duria st.
Corner Acacia and Santol st.; Sapang alat bridge; MLQ High School; Sampaguita st.; and Crispulo st. have no explicit barangay number in the indexed Caloocan rows and are not assigned one.

affected_population_evidence.statement: The later cumulative Annex A row for Caloocan City states: Barangays 6; Families 3,250; Persons 12,754. The row is not interpreted as conditions at the 02 September occurrence point.

evacuation_displacement_evidence.statement: Report #41 lists Caloocan City cumulative evacuation/displacement totals of 8 evacuation centers, 303 families, and 966 persons, with dashes in the current columns; these later cumulative values do not establish flood timing.

flood_passability_depth_evidence.statement: Earlier indexed revisions report source-text depths/status descriptions ranging from Gutter Deep level to 5-6 ft for the ten-location 02 September cluster.
Later indexed revisions report 2-3 feet for Crispulo st. on 05 September 2024 at 07:00 am.

conflicting_incomplete_facts: Reports #1-3 contain no Caloocan reference in extracted text.
Metro Manila rainfall forecasts and statements that flooding may be likely or expected are forecasts/general hazard context, not observed Caloocan flooding.
Report #2 affected-population and displacement totals cover Regions V, VII, and VIII, not Caloocan.

The official NDRRMC attachment files remain not acquired: direct SitRep No. 11 and attempted SitRep No. 16 attachment access returned HTTP 403, while official indexed content remains discovery evidence only.
Report #41 is a later cumulative report. Its affected-population and displacement totals cannot be assigned to 02 September without additional evidence.
The 03, 06, and 07 September DSWD FO NCR entries are relief-response dates and cannot be treated as flood occurrence, onset, or cessation timestamps.

Crispulo st. is listed at 02 September 2024, 08:00 am in SitRep Nos. 2-3, then at 05 September 2024, 07:00 am with 2-3 feet in later revisions. This may be a correction or a separate episode and is not silently merged.
Later Crispulo revisions show a status transition from Flooded to Subsided but do not provide a distinct subsidence timestamp.
uncertainties: Acquired DROMIC Reports #1-3 do not independently corroborate a Caloocan occurrence, onset, cessation, depth, or affected population.
Report #41 corroborates later Caloocan affected-population and response activity, but it does not identify a Caloocan flood occurrence time, onset, cessation, or named affected barangays.
The NDRRMC incident-table timezone is unstated and requires human review before any UTC conversion.
The indexed official content supports a candidate episode envelope but cannot be promoted to acquired raw evidence until an official attachment is obtained and checksummed.
The 03 September 8:00am text is an upper bound expressed as Subsided as of, not an exact cessation instant.
Crispulo st. requires report-revision and episode review before it can be treated as a separate event.
